case_title.quote: CHOTKAU v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: the sole accused has come up with the above appeals

accused_gender.quote: the appellant herein took his niece... the appellant and his mother
accused_gender.reason: Appellant is referred to as 'his'/'son'; male.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated.

accused_religion.reason: No religion stated; names are not to be inferred from.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Labourer (the accused and his brothers are engaged as labourers)
accused_occupation.quote: All the three of them are engaged in the occupation of labourers.
accused_occupation.reason: PW-2 stated the accused's brothers are labourers, so the occupation is stated, though only indirectly; 'Not stated' is wrong.

accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: the appellant is so poor that he could not afford to engage a lawyer

victim_gender.quote: the dead body of the girl

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Alleged to be uncle-niece link per complaint, but the complainant (PW-1) is the victim's uncle and described the girl as 'his niece'; the defence alleged a land dispute with village Pradhan Zalim Khan, who allegedly framed the accused; no direct enmity with victim stated.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: took his niece aged about 6 years
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Niece' belongs to the complainant, not the accused; calling the victim the accused's relative is unsupported. Land dispute context omitted.

offence_category.quote: Convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376
offence_category.reason: Both rape and murder were charged; single category 'Murder' is incomplete though defensible.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code

evidence_type.correct_value: Circumstantial (last seen theory) via PWs 1-3; post-mortem and FSL material not exhibited/proved; no medical examination of accused
evidence_type.quote: the prosecution sought to establish the guilt of the appellant, only through the evidence of PWs 1 to 3
evidence_type.reason: Mostly right, but 'recovery of clothing' and post-mortem were not relied on as established evidence.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: one of the rarest of rare cases where a six year old girl had been raped and murdered

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted the appellant for the offences punishable under Sections 302 and 376 of the IPC and awarded death penalty

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence

final_outcome.quote: the conviction and penalty are set aside

offence_finally_established.quote: the conviction and penalty are set aside

imprisonment_type.quote: conviction and penalty are set aside

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the claim that the victim was a relative of the accused; the victim was the complainant's niece. Also 'during the Holi festival' is fine; the summary should reflect that the accused was reported absent from his house.
neutral_facts.quote: the appellant herein took his niece aged about 6 years under the pretext of showing dance and song performances on the occasion of the Holi Festival
neutral_facts.reason: Wrongly says the victim was the accused's relative; also asserts the vaginal smear and recovery as facts, and includes 'accused' details loosely.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

physical_harm.quote: Blood was coming out of her urinal track, her clothes had torn up and she had died.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: No evidence was accepted; the Court found PWs 1-3 untrustworthy and held the prosecution's failure to medically examine the accused and its FIR delay fatal.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The absence of medical examination is a failure, not evidence relied on.

witness_credibility.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.

trial_duration.reason: Dates correct; trial judgment date not given.

legal_representation.quote: S. Nagamuthu, Sr. Adv.... Ardhendumauli Kumar Prasad, AAG

procedural_irregularity.quote: The Court of the CJM, Shravasti, received the copy of the FIR on 13.03.2012.

appeal_history.quote: the appeals are allowed and the conviction and penalty are set aside

prosecution_argument.quote: there are no reasons for PWs 1 to 3 to implicate the appellant

defence_argument.quote: the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 is untrustworthy; that there was an unexplained delay of five days

legal_principle_applied.quote: the chain of circumstances is complete and unbroken

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda... Rajendra Pralhadrao Wasnik

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
